summary: Frontend-only verification of the presenter cutout poke-out restoration (object-cover object-bottom). All 6 requested checks passed on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080). Image now fills full container height and pokes above the persistent player card as intended, while retaining the wider container from the previous iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: PersistentPlayer.jsx img correctly uses 'object-cover object-bottom' with class 'absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 w-full h-full'. Cutout container keeps '-inset-x-3 md:-inset-x-4' and overflow-visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://blend-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. Accept cookies then scroll ~600px and wait >=8s for isShowView cycle so cutout opacity reaches 1. Measurements: mobile cutout 80x108 (slot 56 + 24 wider), img 80x108 object-fit=cover object-position=50% 100%, pokes 36px above card. Desktop cutout 112x132 (slot 80 + 32 wider), img 112x132 object-fit=cover object-position=50% 100%, pokes 32px above card. No horizontal overflow on either viewport (scrollWidth==innerWidth). Mobile: 5 .blend-ring-flash, mixBlendMode=normal, borderColor rgba(255,255,255,0.38), sphere width 340.
